'''Sin'Dar''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] merchant who worked on the grounds of [[House Organa (estate)|House Organa]], the estate of the noble [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
Sin&#39;Dar appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Mods Vendor for Republic players on Alderaan.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Sin&#39;Dar was removed from the game along with the rest of the Mods Vendors.<ref name="SWTOR" /> Her position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
